'''Vanesa Gottifredi''' (born 13 November 1969) is an Argentine chemist and biologist. She works as a researcher in the Principal Investigator category of the Scientific and Technological Researcher Program (CICT) of the [[National Scientific and Technical Research Council]] (CONICET). She is also head of the [[Leloir Institute]]'s Cell Cycle and Genomic Stability Laboratory. She specializes in the mechanisms of [[tumor]] cell response to [[chemotherapy]], work for which she was awarded by the [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation]] and [[L'Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science Awards|L'Oreal-UNESCO]].

==Career==
Vanesa Gottifredi completed her undergraduate studies at the [[National University of Salta]], where she obtained a [[Licentiate (degree)#Argentina|licentiate]] in chemistry in 1992. She then studied at the [[Sapienza University of Rome]], where she graduated as a doctor in [[human biology]] in 1998.<ref name=busca>{{Cite news |url=https://www.clarin.com/sociedad/cientificas-argentinas-lideran-investigaciones-entender-propaga-cancer_0_BkLpoMLaW.html |title=En busca de nuevos blancos terapéuticos |trans-title=In Search of New Therapeutic Targets |first=Rosario |last=Medina |work=[[Clarín (Argentine newspaper)|Clarín]] |language=Spanish |date=2017-10-19 |access-date=2020-02-07}}</ref> Later she conducted postdoctoral studies in [[cell biology]] and [[cancer]] at [[Columbia University]] in the United States.

As head of the Cell Cycle and Genomic Stability Laboratory at the [[Leloir Institute|Leloir Institute Foundation]], she conducts research on defense mechanisms that both normal and tumor cells use to cope with adverse events, and how malignant cells avoid the effects of [[chemotherapy]].<ref name=busca/><ref name=Rosada>{{Cite web |url=https://www.casarosada.gob.ar/informacion/actividad-oficial/9-noticias/40291-una-cientifica-argentina-recibio-premio-de-fundacion-von-humboldt |title=Una científica argentina recibió premio de fundación Von Humboldt |trans-title=An Argentine Scientist Receives Award from Von Humboldt Foundation |publisher=[[President of Argentina|Office of the President of Argentina]] |language=Spanish |date=2017-08-10 |access-date=2020-02-07}}</ref>

* [[L'Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science Awards|L'Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science Award]] (Argentine national edition), in collaboration with CONICET, 2019<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.clarin.com/sociedad/investiga-celulas-cancer-escapan-quimioterapia-gano-premio-l-oreal-unesco_0_0Xc2YrrQ.html |title=Investiga cómo las células del cáncer le escapan a la quimioterapia y ganó el premio L'Oreal-Unesco |trans-title=Investigates How Cancer Cells Escape Chemotherapy and Wins the L'Oréal-UNESCO Award |first=Vanesa |last=López |work=[[Clarín (Argentine newspaper)|Clarín]] |language=Spanish |date=2019-10-01 |access-date=2020-02-07}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.argentina.gob.ar/noticias/se-entregaron-los-premios-loreal-unesco-por-las-mujeres-en-la-ciencia |title=Se entregaron los Premios L'Oréal-UNESCO 'Por las mujeres en la ciencia' |trans-title=L'Oreal-UNESCO 'For Women in Science' Awards Presented |publisher=[[Ministry of Science, Technology and Productive Innovation]] |language=Spanish |date=2019-03-01 |access-date=2020-02-07}}</ref>
